gates.name: debt_scorecard_budget_violations
gates.remediation: Reduce exemptions or ratchet budgets downward; debt budgets must not grow.

gates.name: retained_public_entrypoint_burden
gates.remediation: Remove retained public entrypoints or lower callers before tightening max_count.

gates.name: debt_budget_growth_policy
gates.remediation: Keep scorecard ratchets non-increasing and fix validation violations.

gates.name: module_coverage_source_tree_hash_current
gates.remediation: Regenerate module coverage inventory before release gate closeout.

gates.name: module_coverage_unmeasured_modules
gates.remediation: Keep reviewed unmeasured-module residual at or below the committed no-growth ratchet.

gates.name: module_coverage_uncovered_modules
gates.remediation: Keep reviewed uncovered-module residual at or below the committed no-growth ratchet.

gates.name: hotspot_family_baseline_budget_warnings
gates.remediation: Reduce hotspot-family metrics to stay at or below reviewed budgets.

gates.name: compatibility_twin_pairs
gates.remediation: Retire twin modules or add explicit reviewed governance before closeout.

gates.name: retained_public_export_facade_growth
gates.remediation: Remove facade exports or update the scorecard only after approved reduction evidence.

gates.name: dead_code_untriaged_zero_import_candidates
gates.remediation: Classify zero-import candidates and attach owner tests before closeout.

gates.name: contract_coverage_missing_gold_enabled
gates.remediation: Add missing Gold contracts or mark Gold runtime disabled explicitly.

gates.name: contract_registry_blocking_drift
gates.remediation: Fix contract registry blocking diagnostics.

gates.name: dq_contract_registry_blocking_drift
gates.remediation: Fix DQ contract diagnostics before closeout.

gates.name: config_discrepancy_inconsistent_parameters
gates.remediation: Resolve config parameter drift or update sanctioned partial classifications.

gates.name: config_discrepancy_raw_inconsistent_parameters
gates.remediation: Regenerate the config matrix only after resolving raw drift.

gates.name: test_governance_budget_violations
gates.remediation: Fix test governance budget violations before closeout.

gates.name: test_governance_uuid4_call_sites
gates.remediation: Replace uuid4 tests with deterministic factories or explicit IDs.

gates.name: production_uuid4_seams
gates.remediation: Remove production uuid4 seams; replay identity must be explicit or deterministic.

gates.name: production_uuid4_budget
gates.remediation: Keep production UUID4 budget at zero.

gates.name: observability_dashboarded_without_emission
gates.remediation: Add runtime emission for dashboarded metrics or remove dashboard references.

gates.name: observability_runtime_cardinality_review_required
gates.remediation: Review high-cardinality metrics and record approved thresholds.

gates.name: observability_runtime_cardinality_threshold_violations
gates.remediation: Reduce label cardinality or explicitly approve bounded thresholds.

gates.name: observability_release_review_status
gates.remediation: Run live observability cardinality review without degraded release evidence.

gates.name: observability_release_review_freshness
gates.remediation: Regenerate live runtime cardinality review evidence.

gates.name: observability_touched_metric_inventory_freshness
gates.remediation: Refresh runtime cardinality inventory evidence before merging metric, dashboard, or alert-rule changes.

gates.name: observability_touched_metric_review_freshness
gates.remediation: Refresh live runtime cardinality review evidence before merging metric, dashboard, or alert-rule changes.

gates.name: adr_enforcement_blocking_gaps
gates.remediation: Add enforcement owner tests/scripts or reviewed manual exception markers for accepted ADRs.

gates.name: remote_main_architecture_debt_baseline
gates.remediation: Fetch origin/main and regenerate the remote-main architecture debt baseline.

gates.name: generated_artifact_drift
gates.remediation: Regenerate stale quality artifacts with their canonical QA commands.
